items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: tonight marks the debut of Joey Calderazzo as a member of the band

ctx.x: Seeing the audience and I kept looking at the clock you know, my head was going back and forth, and tonight marks the debut of Joey Calderazzo as a member of the band so I was listening to Joey, watching the audience and watching the clock at the same time. So it was rough.
Well your James Brown step came off. You know I think it’s a — I like the way you talk to the audience and I think it’s something that a lot of musicians don’t have. It’s important.
